1987 - 1hr 35mins
Horror/Fantasy
A psychiatrist, familiar with the knife-wielding dream demon Freddy Krueger, helps teens at a mental hospital battle the killer who is invading their dreams.

events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
**A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master**
1988 - 1hr 33mins
Horror/Fantasy
Freddy Krueger returns once again to terrorize the dreams of the remaining Dream Warriors, as well as those of a young woman who may be able to defeat him for good.

**A Nightmare on Elm Street 5: The Dream Child**
1989 - 1hr 29mins
Horror/Crime
The pregnant Alice finds Freddy Krueger striking through the sleeping mind of her unborn child, hoping to be reborn into the real world.

events.title: Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare and Wes Craven's New Nightmare
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
**Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare**
1991 - 1hr 33mins
Horror/Comedy
Dream-haunting Freddy Krueger returns once again to prowl the nightmares of Springwood's last surviving teenager, and of a woman whose personal connection to Krueger may mean his doom.

**Wes Craven's New Nightmare**
1994 - 1hr 52mins
Horror/Fantasy
A demonic force has chosen Freddy Krueger as its portal to the real world. Can Heather Langenkamp play the part of Nancy one last time and trap the evil trying to enter our world?
